fields.title: Add a command that shows the curated next list
fields.description: Add endless project next show, also the default for bare project next, which displays the curated next list grouped by lane, hiding tasks in terminal status.
fields.analysis:
Joins project_next_lanes, project_next_tasks, project_next_pending against tasks with render-side terminal-status filter.

Groups by lane sorted by priority asc; same-priority lanes alphabetical.

Formatting design deferred: implementing session writes .endless/plans/E-1440.md proposal first.

fields.title: Add an inferred per-project ranking of next tasks
fields.description: Add endless project next --inferred, a new per-project algorithmic ranking of tasks, separate from the cross-project endless task next.
fields.analysis:
NOT a migration of endless task next (which is cross-project and stays untouched).

May share ranking infrastructure with endless task next but the scope and entry point are new.

Modes: default text, --llm, --json.
